provenance.purpose: Every consumer-visible rename the v1 absorption makes, recorded as it happens.
provenance.rule: A batch that renames anything a consumer can import, target or reference owes a row here, in the same PR. The batch plan lists the rows each batch owes.

schema.kind: component | export | class | token | path — what is being renamed
schema.to: the 1.0 name, or null when the thing is removed with no replacement
schema.batch: the batch number that made the change
schema.note: optional — why, or what a consumer has to do beyond a find-and-replace
